title: Completed Team Psychological Safety and Wellbeing Index Data Contract
description: Additive structural schema validating completed Team Psychological Safety and Wellbeing Index artifact data payloads (PMO-04.06.06).

assessment_period_and_cadence.description: The evaluation sprint, sprint cadence, and designated survey period for measuring team psychological safety and cognitive well-being.

facilitator_and_working_model.description: The designated agile coach, scrum master, or people lead facilitating the assessment, and the team's working arrangement (Co-located, Hybrid, or Fully Remote).

team_response_participation_rate.description: The percentage of team members participating in the anonymous assessment to validate sample representation.

vulnerability_and_open_inquiry_score.description: Aggregated rating reflecting team members' comfort in asking questions, admitting mistakes, and seeking help without fear of penalty.

constructive_dissent_and_innovation_scor.description: Aggregated rating reflecting psychological comfort in challenging assumptions, proposing novel ideas, and offering dissenting views.

blameless_culture_and_mutual_support_sco.description: Aggregated rating reflecting perceived team trust, peer collaboration, and constructive root-cause problem solving.

cognitive_load_and_overtime_health.description: Quantitative assessment of sustained work pressure, cognitive context-switching frequency, and overtime hours worked.

focus_time_and_meeting_load_ratio.description: Ratio of uninterrupted deep-work focus time compared to total hours spent in synchronous meetings and ceremonies.

well_being_action_and_working_agreement_.description: Agreed interventions, meeting hygiene rules, focus-block policies, or team charter amendments enacted to protect team vitality.
